ready.description: Cursor interactive ready prompt accepting a new message

idle.description: Cursor interactive follow-up/idle prompt after a settled turn

question.description: Cursor trust, authorization, approval, or other decision prompt

transcript.freshness: supervisor mapping source.start_offset, source.launch_mtime_ns, source.exists_at_launch, and source.created_after_launch are required; zero is valid only for a source created after launch; existing sources require path/device/inode/size/mtime identity; reject truncation, replacement, and stale source identity
transcript.prompt_echo_rule: exclude user records and exact or segment prompt echoes; reject markers present only in submitted input, reflected prompt echo, or screen text
transcript.authoritative_content: only fresh assistant/tool records normalized from the first usable hook-provided transcript_path

bridge.status: additive hook observations and transcript capture
bridge.path_rule: capture the first usable non-null CURSOR_TRANSCRIPT_PATH or transcript_path supplied by a correlated hook; null or future paths are observations only; never scan undocumented Cursor directories
bridge.normalization: fresh complete JSONL records after the supervisor boundary; preserve source offsets; exclude user records and exact/segment prompt echoes; deduplicate semantic replay; reject malformed/truncated/replaced/uncorrelated sources

watcher.poll_strategy: stat identity plus persisted byte cursors; bounded appended NDJSON reads only
watcher.pane_rule: read only the exact recorded workspace/surface after five seconds without result activity; explicit follow-up/idle corroboration is required; no automatic approvals

advisor.reset_on: fresh correlated transcript or bridge-event activity
advisor.approval_rule: only an exact displayed command accepted independently by the bounded read-only policy may be recommended as routine; the advisor never sends approval
advisor.failure_rule: malformed, timed out, unavailable, or non-routine advisor responses fail closed and escalate

supervisor_mapping.ownership: supervisor-generated and supervisor-validated; job text, profile argv, hook payloads, and pane text cannot override identity

result.turn_settled_gate: fresh correlated assistant marker plus artifact/check evidence plus no active question/approval plus explicitly targeted pane at normal follow-up/idle prompt

lifecycle.optional_stop_status_rule: stop is a wakeup/status check; stop error or aborted fails closed; missing stop never downgrades transcript, artifact, and idle validation
